bio: Dating back to 1904, this spruce urban villa has been known as a stylish culinary destination for aeons. Owners Klaus Weingartz (kitchen) and Elke Zeitner (front of house) have been running this establishment with great dedication since 2011. Ambitious classic cuisine made with select ingredients is served by charming waitstaff in comfortable and elegant dining rooms with high ceilings, or out on the gorgeous terrace. Set menus can even be pre-ordered to take home. Cookery classes and overnight accommodation are also available....
